fields.body: For Alpine Hub, add two handholes at the east gate, beyond the zero shown on original C-14. I am the named owner PM on the project directory and authorize this revised scope for pricing and notice review. Receipt confirmed by the superintendent at 09:00.
Alpine Hub only: revision adds HH-1 and HH-2 at east gate. Original contract issue C-14 had no handholes there. Do not apply this sheet to Birch Hub.

Checked original C-14 and Rev 2 with Rae. Crew excavated two new handhole pits at Alpine east gate following the received direction. Photographs and measured dimensions entered in the daily register; routine south-loop backfill also completed.
